_help: What one point/mile is typically worth, in cents. Economy-weighted 'what you should expect' values (upgradedpoints.com, cross-checked against thepointsguy.com and frequentmiler.com, Sept 2026) matching how this app prices fares (cheapest comparable fare). Business/first redemptions genuinely return more per point, so bars for those cabins use business_values where published, else economy x business_multiplier. A deal is a standout only above baseline x GREAT_MULTIPLE (valuation.py). Re-check a few times a year.
_business_help: Per-program business/first baselines where published redemption data exists (awardwallet.com averages of real bookings, Sept 2026). Others fall back to economy x business_multiplier.
